notes.title: Update Notes for 04/12/2024
notes.notes:
Tree tilt has been adjusted to not allow climbing
 Minimum height for fall damage increased
 Crate spawn fixed
 Fixed knife damage


Thanks to everyone who tested the game and reported their issues!

I especially thank 00Mx, a Brazilian streamer who gave me excellent feedback.

If you would like to give me feedback about the game or report issues, please contact me by email: gabrieljacintho@fireringstudio.com.
